title: Homogenization of compressible Navier-Stokes equations under a hard sphere pressure law
summary: We consider the compressible time-dependent Navier-Stokes equations in a bounded perforated domain in dimensions two and three. Provided the perforations are small enough, we show that the limiting equations do not change their form when the perforation size goes to zero while their number increases to infinity.
